_readme: FIAT BOSS BACKDROPS, THE SET (25 Oct): every boss's plate and wall (14 jobs: four heads, three pinnacles). After the test reads; the test's Manager is skipped as made.

Run: tools\art.bat boss_backdrops   (the dry run first, then it asks; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <boss>_plate ++ --force; or godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_boss_backdrops_manifest.json)

Boss backdrops: art/fight_boss/<boss>_plate.png 744x320 and _cover.png 744x256 (the wall's body filling the lower 85% down to the bottom edge, as art/fight_walls/). A head's pair styled on his site's live pair; a pinnacle's on his host site's pair with his map card (art/places/) as a reference image. Nothing live is touched.
The code doesn't show them yet: RunView.tex() needs art/fight_boss/ in its folders and a boss's fight needs _site(<boss>) (Matt's go first).
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_boss_backdrops_manifest.py; check with python3 tools/art_lint.py.

jobs.description: A first-person view at crouching eye level, as if from behind cover in a light-gun arcade game, looking into the gamekeeper's larder at the back of a stone farm barn, its big doors open onto a muddy yard: a rail of dead pheasants hung by their necks from a beam, rusted gin traps and wire snares on nails along the wall, a game cart, galvanised feed bins, straw bales, a chest freezer with its lid up, a torn pheasant pen in the yard beyond. Nobody in the scene, empty and waiting. Composed for three figures to stand in later: clear open ground in the middle distance just right of centre, a dark doorway or gap on the left side well down the scene, and room in the right foreground. The ground runs across the lower third; the horizon sits a third of the way down. One continuous scene edge to edge: no repeated sections, no seams. The painting fills the whole canvas right to all four edges: no border, no frame, no margin, no empty space around it. Any signs, boards or fascias are blank, with no lettering on them. The bottom fifth of the scene is plain open ground running to the frame's edge, nothing standing in the foreground: no walls, rubble or cover there, it is drawn over later. Realistic painted pixel art, soft overcast light, muted cool northern palette, worn and lived-in, post-collapse Britain on a grey day; no black outlines, not anime, not a cartoon, not glossy; no text, no logos.
jobs._where: The Gamekeeper's fight, the plate: his den at top_farm (styled on art/fight_new/top_farm_plate.png)

Everything on it plain and unprinted, no lettering, numbers or pictures anywhere.
